notes: The page continues a compatibility argument: a cycle-induced map R^1 g_* → R^{2n−1} f_* induces a map on H^1(S,−); the author identifies u(x) with the image of u(x′), then uses vanishing of the map to obtain vanishing of u(x). The fibre formulation is included literally, with est nulle.

Section 2 introduces i:Y→X for schemes whose corrected adjective reads propres, and rational-coefficient odd cohomology after both Z-to-Q corrections. Hypothesis a) asks for an algebraic reverse homomorphism restricting to a right inverse on the image of i*.

The author writes conjectures standart and donc est sans doute touhours vérifiée. Both source spellings and the reservation sans doute are retained. The subsequent hyperplane/Lambda/lifting assertions are transcribed, not proved.

Degree consistency flags the closed 2/a glyph but does not decide it. A clean 2 occurs on the left of (***), while a-like closed impressions recur elsewhere on this same page. The first occurrence remains explicitly uncertain.
The inverse condition is domain/codomain coherent when interpreted on im(i*); it does not assert that the reverse map is a two-sided inverse on the full cohomology spaces.

The equivalence between zero map and zero on the indicated geometric fibre was not established from this page alone: the surrounding hypotheses that could justify it are not imported from other pages.

Typed pro and final s survive the projectifs→propres correction. The handwritten part is therefore confined to pre; deletion is confined to jectif. The Q replacements are pen, contrary to H’s explicit typing claim.
No handwriting wrapper is added merely because a degree numeral lacks a serif. The mechanically repeated index/class glyph is treated as an alphabet uncertainty, not silently normalized to ell.

The property insertion’s faint curved leader provides placement. Its hooked right end is not counted as a comma. The full paragraph keeps its original NB parenthesis and final period before the closing parenthesis.

H’s statements about g and explanatory notes are editorial apparatus, not source text. The one content note about g is recorded as absent from the page; neutral source-description notes are used only for collation.

check_events.outcome: Conditional local check performed: for an additive cohomology functor H^1(S,−), a zero coefficient-sheaf morphism F→G induces the zero map on H^1. Combining this with the page’s asserted identity u(x)=image(u(x′)) gives u(x)=0. This checks only the last implication under the stated compatibility, not compatibility itself or the fibre-detection equivalence.

Conditional linear-algebra check performed. Put T:A→B and V:B→A, and assume TV(y)=y for every y in im(T), exactly the right-inverse-on-image reading. For P=TV, P(B) is contained in im(T), and P^2(b)=TV(Pb)=Pb because Pb lies in im(T); moreover P is identity on im(T), so im(P)=im(T). Thus the source condition is coherent and gives a projection, without requiring VT=id_A. No algebraicity, standard-conjecture, hyperplane, or lifting assertion was proved.
